glossary.definition: (B) For purposes of this section, "constructed" means the creation of multifamily rental housing units through new construction or the conversion of an existing nonresidential building into multifamily rental housing units.
glossary.source_title: Section 175.07 - Notice by applicant for funding for multifamily rental housing construction.
